我要做一个农场废旧农膜回收称重与补贴资格系统。回收站登记收料和分拣结果，审核人员确认补贴资格，种植户可以查看自己交了多少农膜以及最终能领取多少补贴。

每次过磅记录种植户、地块、膜种类、毛重和皮重，分拣后补充净重与质量等级。只有审核通过的数量才能进入补贴清单。管理页面按地块展示回收量、合格量和已兑付量，种植户只能查自己的收据与处理进度。

泥土夹杂过多或同一批膜重复过磅时，不得直接计入补贴。修正称重结果要保留原值、原因和复核人，补贴数量同时受地块面积及当期额度限制。收料员不能审批自己的单据，重复提交与兑付也不能增加补贴金额。

使用 TypeScript、NestJS 和 Prisma 实现后端，React 实现前端，数据存入 SQLite。地磅读数及兑付回执在本地模拟，项目应支持一条本地命令启动。交付示例要覆盖重量修正、重复交膜和额度刚好达到上限的情况。

// 农膜回收称重与补贴系统 —— SQLite 数据模型
generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

/// 系统用户：种植户 / 收料员 / 审核人员 / 管理员
model User {
  id           Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  username     String   @unique
  passwordHash String
  name         String
  // FARMER | COLLECTOR | REVIEWER | ADMIN
  role         String
  phone        String?
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())

  plots           Plot[]
  collected       WeighRecord[]      @relation("Collector")
  sorted          WeighRecord[]      @relation("Sorter")
  reviewed        WeighRecord[]      @relation("Reviewer")
  corrections     WeightCorrection[]
  paymentsMade    Payment[]          @relation("PaymentOperator")
  paymentsReceived Payment[]         @relation("PaymentFarmer")
}

/// 地块：补贴数量受面积上限约束
model Plot {
  id       Int     @id @default(autoincrement())
  code     String  @unique
  name     String
  areaMu   Float // 面积（亩）
  crop     String? // 种植作物
  farmerId Int
  farmer   User    @relation(fields: [farmerId], references: [id])

  records WeighRecord[]
}

/// 补贴当期：全期总额度 + 每亩面积折算上限 + 统一收购价
model SubsidyPeriod {
  id            Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  code          String   @unique
  name          String
  startAt       String
  endAt         String
  totalQuotaYuan Float // 当期补贴总额度（元）
  usedQuotaYuan  Float   @default(0) // 已核定占用额度（元）
  perMuCapKg    Float // 每亩合格农膜上限（kg/亩）
  pricePerKg    Float // 补贴单价（元/kg）
  active        Boolean @default(true)

  records  WeighRecord[]
  payments Payment[]
}

/// 过磅单据（一张票据贯穿 过磅→分拣→审核→兑付）
model WeighRecord {
  id       Int    @id @default(autoincrement())
  ticketNo String @unique
  // 客户端幂等键：重复提交返回原单据，不重复计量
  clientTicketNo String? @unique

  periodId Int
  period   SubsidyPeriod @relation(fields: [periodId], references: [id])
  farmerId Int
  farmer   User          @relation(fields: [farmerId], references: [id])
  plotId   Int
  plot     Plot          @relation(fields: [plotId], references: [id])

  filmType String // 膜种类：PE / PVC / EVA / PO
  // 毛重（带泥土杂物）、皮重（包装物）、过磅净重 = 毛重 - 皮重
  grossWeightKg Float
  tareWeightKg  Float
  netWeightKg   Float
  // 分拣后补充：实测净重与质量等级
  sortedNetWeightKg Float?
  // A | B | C | REJECT
  grade             String?
  qualityNote       String?

  // PENDING（待分拣） | SORTED（待审核） | APPROVED（审核通过） | REJECTED（驳回）
  status           String  @default("PENDING")
  rejectReason     String? // SOIL_CONTAMINATION | DUPLICATE_FILM | OTHER
  suspectedDuplicate Boolean @default(false)
  duplicateOfId    Int?
  duplicateOf      WeighRecord? @relation("DuplicateLink", fields: [duplicateOfId], references: [id])
  duplicates       WeighRecord[] @relation("DuplicateLink")

  collectorId Int
  collector   User @relation("Collector", fields: [collectorId], references: [id])
  sortedById  Int?
  sortedBy    User? @relation("Sorter", fields: [sortedById], references: [id])
  reviewedById Int?
  reviewedBy   User? @relation("Reviewer", fields: [reviewedById], references: [id])

  // 审核通过后核定：经等级折算、面积上限、当期额度三重约束后的最终补贴量/金额
  approvedSubsidyKg Float @default(0)
  subsidyYuan       Float @default(0)
  cappedByPlot      Boolean @default(false) // 被地块面积上限截断
  cappedByPeriod    Boolean @default(false) // 被当期额度截断
  isPaid            Boolean @default(false)

  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())
  sortedAt    DateTime?
  reviewedAt  DateTime?

  corrections WeightCorrection[]
  payment     Payment?
}

/// 称重修正留痕：原值、新值、原因、复核人
model WeightCorrection {
  id        Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  recordId  Int
  record    WeighRecord @relation(fields: [recordId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  // GROSS_WEIGHT | TARE_WEIGHT | SORTED_NET_WEIGHT | GRADE
  field     String
  oldValue  String?
  newValue  String?
  reason    String
  reviewerId Int
  reviewer  User     @relation(fields: [reviewerId], references: [id])
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
}

/// 兑付记录：一票一兑付（recordId 唯一），回执号唯一，天然防重复兑付
model Payment {
  id              Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  recordId        Int      @unique
  record          WeighRecord @relation(fields: [recordId], references: [id])
  farmerId        Int
  farmer          User     @relation("PaymentFarmer", fields: [farmerId], references: [id])
  periodId        Int
  period          SubsidyPeriod @relation(fields: [periodId], references: [id])
  amountKg        Float
  amountYuan      Float
  receiptNo       String   @unique // 本地模拟的兑付回执号
  idempotencyKey  String   @unique
  paidBy          Int
  operator        User     @relation("PaymentOperator", fields: [paidBy], references: [id])
  paidAt          DateTime @default(now())
}

/// 地磅读数留痕（本地模拟设备）
model ScaleReading {
  id        Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  ticketNo  String
  grossKg   Float
  tareKg    Float
  stable    Boolean
  deviceId  String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
}

// 农膜回收称重与补贴系统 —— SQLite 数据模型
generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

/// 系统用户：种植户 / 收料员 / 审核人员 / 管理员
model User {
  id           Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  username     String   @unique
  passwordHash String
  name         String
  // FARMER | COLLECTOR | REVIEWER | ADMIN
  role         String
  phone        String?
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())

  plots           Plot[]
  collected       WeighRecord[]      @relation("Collector")
  sorted          WeighRecord[]      @relation("Sorter")
  reviewed        WeighRecord[]      @relation("Reviewer")
  corrections     WeightCorrection[]
  paymentsMade    Payment[]          @relation("PaymentOperator")
  paymentsReceived Payment[]         @relation("PaymentFarmer")
}

/// 地块：补贴数量受面积上限约束
model Plot {
  id       Int     @id @default(autoincrement())
  code     String  @unique
  name     String
  areaMu   Float // 面积（亩）
  crop     String? // 种植作物
  farmerId Int
  farmer   User    @relation(fields: [farmerId], references: [id])

  records WeighRecord[]
}

/// 补贴当期：全期总额度 + 每亩面积折算上限 + 统一收购价
model SubsidyPeriod {
  id            Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  code          String   @unique
  name          String
  startAt       String
  endAt         String
  totalQuotaYuan Float // 当期补贴总额度（元）
  usedQuotaYuan  Float   @default(0) // 已核定占用额度（元）
  perMuCapKg    Float // 每亩合格农膜上限（kg/亩）
  pricePerKg    Float // 补贴单价（元/kg）
  active        Boolean @default(true)

  records  WeighRecord[]
  payments Payment[]
}

/// 过磅单据（一张票据贯穿 过磅→分拣→审核→兑付）
model WeighRecord {
  id       Int    @id @default(autoincrement())
  ticketNo String @unique
  // 客户端幂等键：重复提交返回原单据，不重复计量
  clientTicketNo String? @unique

  periodId Int
  period   SubsidyPeriod @relation(fields: [periodId], references: [id])
  farmerId Int
  farmer   User          @relation(fields: [farmerId], references: [id])
  plotId   Int
  plot     Plot          @relation(fields: [plotId], references: [id])

  filmType String // 膜种类：PE / PVC / EVA / PO
  // 毛重（带泥土杂物）、皮重（包装物）、过磅净重 = 毛重 - 皮重
  grossWeightKg Float
  tareWeightKg  Float
  netWeightKg   Float
  // 分拣后补充：实测净重与质量等级
  sortedNetWeightKg Float?
  // A | B | C | REJECT
  grade             String?
  qualityNote       String?

  // PENDING（待分拣） | SORTED（待审核） | APPROVED（审核通过） | REJECTED（驳回）
  status           String  @default("PENDING")
  rejectReason     String? // SOIL_CONTAMINATION | DUPLICATE_FILM | OTHER
  suspectedDuplicate Boolean @default(false)
  duplicateOfId    Int?
  duplicateOf      WeighRecord? @relation("DuplicateLink", fields: [duplicateOfId], references: [id])
  duplicates       WeighRecord[] @relation("DuplicateLink")

  collectorId Int
  collector   User @relation("Collector", fields: [collectorId], references: [id])
  sortedById  Int?
  sortedBy    User? @relation("Sorter", fields: [sortedById], references: [id])
  reviewedById Int?
  reviewedBy   User? @relation("Reviewer", fields: [reviewedById], references: [id])

  // 审核通过后核定：经等级折算、面积上限、当期额度三重约束后的最终补贴量/金额
  approvedSubsidyKg Float @default(0)
  subsidyYuan       Float @default(0)
  cappedByPlot      Boolean @default(false) // 被地块面积上限截断
  cappedByPeriod    Boolean @default(false) // 被当期额度截断
  isPaid            Boolean @default(false)

  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())
  sortedAt    DateTime?
  reviewedAt  DateTime?

  corrections WeightCorrection[]
  payment     Payment?
}

/// 称重修正留痕：原值、新值、原因、复核人
model WeightCorrection {
  id        Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  recordId  Int
  record    WeighRecord @relation(fields: [recordId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  // GROSS_WEIGHT | TARE_WEIGHT | SORTED_NET_WEIGHT | GRADE
  field     String
  oldValue  String?
  newValue  String?
  reason    String
  reviewerId Int
  reviewer  User     @relation(fields: [reviewerId], references: [id])
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
}

/// 兑付记录：一票一兑付（recordId 唯一），回执号唯一，天然防重复兑付
model Payment {
  id              Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  recordId        Int      @unique
  record          WeighRecord @relation(fields: [recordId], references: [id])
  farmerId        Int
  farmer          User     @relation("PaymentFarmer", fields: [farmerId], references: [id])
  periodId        Int
  period          SubsidyPeriod @relation(fields: [periodId], references: [id])
  amountKg        Float
  amountYuan      Float
  receiptNo       String   @unique // 本地模拟的兑付回执号
  idempotencyKey  String   @unique
  paidBy          Int
  operator        User     @relation("PaymentOperator", fields: [paidBy], references: [id])
  paidAt          DateTime @default(now())
}

/// 地磅读数留痕（本地模拟设备）
model ScaleReading {
  id        Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  ticketNo  String
  grossKg   Float
  tareKg    Float
  stable    Boolean
  deviceId  String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# 一条本地命令启动农膜回收称重与补贴系统：
#   安装依赖 → 生成 Prisma Client → 建库(SQLite) → 种子数据 → 并行启动 API(3000) 与 Web(5173)
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

echo "🌱 农膜回收称重与补贴系统 —— 本地启动"

if [ ! -d node_modules ]; then
  echo "① 安装依赖…"
  npm install --no-audit --no-fund
fi

cd backend
echo "② 生成 Prisma Client 并创建 SQLite 数据库…"
npx prisma generate >/dev/null
npx prisma db push >/dev/null
if [ ! -s prisma/dev.db ] || ! command -v sqlite3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then :; fi

echo "③ 写入演示种子数据（幂等，可重复执行）…"
npx cross-env DATABASE_URL=file:./dev.db tsx prisma/seed.ts
cd ..

echo "④ 启动后端 http://localhost:3000 与前端 http://localhost:5173 …"
echo "   演示账号：zhang/collector/reviewer/admin，密码统一 123456"
echo "   按 Ctrl+C 停止"
exec npx concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green \
  "npm run dev -w backend" \
  "npm run dev -w frontend"

input.command:
set -e
BASE=http://localhost:3000/api
j() { python3 -c "import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(eval(sys.argv[1]))" "$1"; }

TOKEN_C=$(curl -s -X POST $BASE/auth/login -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"username":"collector","password":"123456"}' | j "d['token']")
TOKEN_R=$(curl -s -X POST $BASE/auth/login -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"username":"reviewer","password":"123456"}' | j "d['token']")
TOKEN_A=$(curl -s -X POST $BASE/auth/login -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"username":"admin","password":"123456"}' | j "d['token']")
TOKEN_Z=$(curl -s -X POST $BASE/auth/login -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"username":"zhang","password":"123456"}' | j "d['token']")
echo "1) 四类角色登录 OK"

READING=$(curl -s -X POST $BASE/scale/read -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN_C" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"expectedGross":130,"expectedTare":6}')
echo "2) 地磅读数: $READING"
GROSS=$(echo "$READING" | j "d['grossKg']"); TARE=$(echo "$READING" | j "d['tareKg']")

KEY="HTTP-SMOKE-$(date +%s)"
W1=$(curl -s -X POST $BASE/records -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN_C" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"plotId\":1,\"filmType\":\"PE\",\"grossWeightKg\":$GROSS,\"tareWeightKg\":$TARE,\"clientTicketNo\":\"$KEY\"}")
W2=$(curl -s -X POST $BASE/records -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN_C" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"plotId\":1,\"filmType\":\"PE\",\"grossWeightKg\":$GROSS,\"tareWeightKg\":$TARE,\"clientTicketNo\":\"$KEY\"}")
RID=$(echo "$W1" | j "d['record']['id']")
RID2=$(echo "$W2" | j "d['record']['id']")
REPLAY=$(echo "$W2" | j "d.get('idempotentReplay')")
echo "3) 过磅登记 id=$RID, 重复提交幂等: $([ "$RID" = "$RID2" ] && [ "$REPLAY" = "True" ] && echo OK)"

curl -s -X POST $BASE/records/$RID/sorting -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN_C" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"sortedNetWeightKg":100,"grade":"A","qualityNote":"http冒烟"}' >/dev/null
echo "4) 分拣补录 OK"

SELF=$(curl -s -X POST $BASE/records/$RID/review -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN_C" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"decision":"APPROVE"}')
echo "5) 收料员自审 → $(echo "$SELF" | j "d['message']")"

APPR=$(curl -s -X POST $BASE/records/$RID/review -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN_R" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"decision":"APPROVE"}')
echo "6) 审核员通过: 核定 $(echo "$APPR" | j "d['record']['approvedSubsidyKg']")kg / $(echo "$APPR" | j "d['record']['subsidyYuan']")元, 地块截断=$(echo "$APPR" | j "d['record']['cappedByPlot']")"

P1=$(curl -s -X POST $BASE/payments/records/$RID/pay -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN_A" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"idempotencyKey":"smoke-pay"}')
P2=$(curl -s -X POST $BASE/payments/records/$RID/pay -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN_A" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"idempotencyKey":"smoke-pay"}')
RC1=$(echo "$P1" | j "d['payment']['receiptNo']"); RC2=$(echo "$P2" | j "d['payment']['receiptNo']")
echo "7) 兑付回执 $RC1; 重复兑付回执一致=$([ "$RC1" = "$RC2" ] && echo OK), 幂等标记=$(echo "$P2" | j "d.get('idempotentReplay')")"

FARMER=$(curl -s "$BASE/records" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN_Z")
LI=$(curl -s -X POST $BASE/auth/login -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"username":"li","password":"123456"}' | j "d['token']")
LI_CNT=$(curl -s "$BASE/records" -H "Authorization: Bearer $LI" | j "len(d)")
echo "8) 种植户 zhang 可见单据 $(echo "$FARMER" | j "len(d)") 张；种植户 li 可见 $LI_CNT 张（数据隔离）"

STATS=$(curl -s "$BASE/stats/by-plot" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN_A")
echo "9) 按地块统计 P-01: 回收=$(echo "$STATS" | j "d['plots'][0]['recycledKg']")kg 合格=$(echo "$STATS" | j "d['plots'][0]['qualifiedKg']")kg 已兑付=$(echo "$STATS" | j "d['plots'][0]['paidYuan']")元"

FORBID=$(curl -s -X POST $BASE/records -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN_Z" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"plotId":1,"filmType":"PE","grossWeightKg":10,"tareWeightKg":1}')
echo "10) 种植户尝试过磅登记 → $(echo "$FORBID" | j "d['message']")"

# 🌱 农场废旧农膜回收称重与补贴资格系统

回收站登记收料与分拣结果，审核人员确认补贴资格，种植户查询交膜量与补贴金额，管理员按地块监管回收/合格/兑付并控制当期额度。

## 一条命令启动

```bash
bash start.sh
```

脚本自动完成：安装依赖 → 生成 Prisma Client → 创建 SQLite 数据库 → 写入种子数据 → 并行启动后端与前端。

- 前端：<http://localhost:5173>
- 后端 API：<http://localhost:3000/api>
- 停止：`Ctrl+C`

前置条件：Node.js ≥ 18（开发环境为 Node 22），首次启动会自动执行 `npm install`。

### 演示账号（密码统一 `123456`）

| 用户名 | 角色 | 能做什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `zhang` / `li` | 种植户 | 只能查看**本人**的收据、处理进度、核定补贴与兑付回执 |
| `collector` | 收料员 | 模拟地磅读数、过磅登记、分拣补录（不能审批自己的单据） |
| `reviewer` | 审核人员 | 称重修正（留痕）、补贴资格通过/驳回、解除重复嫌疑 |
| `admin` | 管理员 | 按地块统计、查看当期额度、发起兑付 |

## 业务流程

```
过磅登记（毛重/皮重，地磅读数留痕）
   └─> 分拣补录（净重 + 质量等级 A/B/C/拒收）
          └─> 审核（修正留痕 / 驳回泥膜·重复膜 / 通过）
                 └─> 补贴核定（等级折算 → 地块面积上限 → 当期额度）
                        └─> 兑付（本地模拟回执，一票一回执）
```

## 核心规则与实现位置

| 规则 | 实现 |
| --- | --- |
| 只有审核通过的数量进入补贴清单 | `WeighRecord.status = APPROVED` 后才写 `approvedSubsidyKg/subsidyYuan`（`records.service.ts` `review()`） |
| 泥土夹杂过多不得直接计补 | 分拣等级 C/拒收折算系数为 0，审核通过被拒，须按 `SOIL_CONTAMINATION` 驳回（`domain.ts` `GRADE_FACTOR`） |
| 同一批膜重复过磅 | 同地块+同膜种、净重差 ≤2kg、30 分钟窗口内自动标记 `suspectedDuplicate`，审核通过被拒，须核实后驳回（`DUPLICATE_FILM`）或填写核实结论解除嫌疑 |
| 称重修正保留原值/原因/复核人 | `WeightCorrection` 表记录字段、原值、新值、原因、复核人；修正毛/皮重自动重算净重；**不能修正本人登记的单** |
| 补贴数量受地块面积限制 | 按当期同地块已核定量累计，上限 = 面积(亩) × `perMuCapKg`，超出部分截断并标记 `cappedByPlot` |
| 补贴数量受当期额度限制 | 总额度 `totalQuotaYuan - usedQuotaYuan`，金额先按分取整再反推公斤数，永不超额，标记 `cappedByPeriod` |
| 收料员不能审批自己的单据 | `review()` 内校验 `collectorId !== 当前用户`（管理员也可审） |
